title: Product Comparison Video: Side by Side | AIVideosUGC
description: Make a product comparison video that puts two of your own colors, sizes, or models side by side. Get a 1:1 or 16:9 clip for your listing or Shorts. Try it.
h1: Make a Product Comparison Video of Your Own Options
lead: A product comparison video helps shoppers choose between your own colors, sizes, or models. Upload a photo of both, say what sets them apart, and get a short side-by-side clip.
intro: A comparison ad can help shoppers choose between two finishes, fits, or sizes. Show both options in one frame or have a creator explain the visible difference while holding them.

Comparison clips answer practical questions about color, size, fit and packaging. Show your own options together, then add variant names and current prices in an editable layer. Use 1:1, 16:9 or 9:16 for the placement you need.
tip: Photograph both options together and describe one visible difference, such as color, size, finish or included pieces.

steps.t: Upload both options in one photo
steps.d: Set the two products side by side on a plain surface so the video keeps them at the right scale.
Describe what sets them apart: color, size, lid, or finish. Use 6 seconds for a fast glance or 15 for a slow pan across both.
Add names, sizes, and prices above each product in Canva or CapCut after you download.

ideas.d: Stand your small and large bottles together so buyers see the real difference in height.
Show your updated design next to the previous one so returning customers recognize it.
Compare one item with your gift set to show which pieces come in the bundle.

faq.q: Can I compare my product with another brand's?
faq.a: No. Use this template to compare options from your own range, like two colors or two sizes. Requests that include other companies' logos or trademarks may be refused.

faq.q: Can the video show capacity, weight, or price?
faq.a: Add specs like these as text in your editor after downloading. Generated numbers aren't always accurate, so it's safer to type them yourself.

faq.q: Which aspect ratio should I choose?
faq.a: Square 1:1 works well in product galleries and feeds. Widescreen 16:9 suits a video in your product description. Vertical 9:16 is for YouTube Shorts and other phone-first feeds.

faq.q: Can the clip show measurements on screen?
faq.a: Numbers are added as a text layer after download so they stay exact. The clip can show both options side by side as you demonstrate them.
A 10-second clip usually covers both options; choose 15 seconds when each one needs a demonstration. They cost 40 or 60 credits.

faq.q: Can I compare two of my own products?
faq.a: Yes. Upload both options together and describe which feature each side should show.

overview.h2: Compare what the camera can actually show
overview.d: A side-by-side clip is useful for color, size, finish, included pieces, or packaging. Keep the two items in one stable composition and let viewers inspect the difference; put performance claims and exact specifications in your product listing.

overview.h2: Keep the comparison about your range
overview.d: Use this template for your own variants, sizes, or bundles. It can clarify a choice without naming or implying a competing brand, and it leaves the final decision with the shopper.

input_guide.h2: Photograph both options for fair scale

items.d: Place both items on the same plain surface so the scene does not invent a scale difference.
Front views work for color and packaging; a three-quarter view can reveal a lid, handle, or side port on both products.
A small space between the options gives each label and silhouette room after the clip is downloaded.
Say charcoal versus cream, 12-ounce versus 20-ounce, or single item versus set instead of asking for a general comparison.
The clip can make color, form, packaging, or included pieces easy to inspect in one frame.
Use 1:1 for a listing or feed, 16:9 for a wide product section, or 9:16 for Stories and Reels.
Use current listing data for prices, capacities, dimensions and included pieces.
An adult creator holds a small and large bottle side by side, with both full silhouettes visible.
A creator holds matte black and brushed silver headphones at equal height.
Two creators wear charcoal and navy versions of the same legging cut in matched poses.
Show sage and blush cases together, each with one circular camera opening.

after_download.h2: Add facts the scene cannot show

items.d: Place the variant name, size, color, or model above the correct side.
Use current listing data for price, capacity, dimensions, and included pieces.
Describe the visible difference without adding a performance winner the clip cannot prove.

visual.overview: A comparison ad lets shoppers see one difference between two options. Use a side-by-side view, wear test, or creator review, and keep claims to what the image can show.

steps.sourceTitle: Two sizes of an amber glass bottle
steps.sourceHint: Keep the small and large amber bottles, white droppers and blank labels fully visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded pair as the exact options: one small and one large amber glass dropper bottle with white rubber bulbs, ribbed white caps and blank white labels. Preserve each bottle silhouette, cap and relative size. An adult creator holds one bottle in each hand beside her face and says, "Here are the two sizes side by side." She raises both equally and finishes with the full bottles facing the lens. Bright vanity daylight, natural skin texture. Chest-up front-facing handheld framing. Sound: her voice and two soft bottle taps; no music.

picker.title: Choose a product-comparison ad format
picker.lead: Show a visible difference between two of your own options in one clear frame or creator review.

cards.label: Talking-Head Compare: serum finishes
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square comparison ad still: an adult creator holds two amber serum bottles with different finishes at equal height, fronts facing the camera. Bright vanity daylight, natural skin texture, chest-up composition. Freeze a clear side-by-side review moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Talking-Head Compare: headphone fit
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square comparison ad still: an adult creator wears one plain over-ear headphone fit and holds a matching second pair beside his shoulder. Show both ear cups and headbands clearly. Soft desk daylight, chest-up tech-demo composition. No brand marks, text, or watermark.

cards.label: Side-by-Side Demo: skincare bottles
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square comparison ad still: two hands hold plain skincare bottles side by side, showing the visible packaging and finish difference. Bright bathroom vanity light, close composition, both full bottles in frame. Freeze the comparison moment. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Wear Test: two athletic fits
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square split-screen fitness ad still: two adult creators wear a matching athletic legging cut in charcoal and navy, shown from waist to ankle in matched poses. Bright studio daylight, balanced side-by-side framing. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Side-by-Side Demo: sneaker colorways
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square sports comparison ad still: two adult runners wear charcoal trail sneakers in two colorways on a city path, both pairs fully visible. Cool natural daylight, low close framing, matched planted steps. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Fit Compare: pet harness sizes
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square pet comparison ad still: an adult owner holds two green harness sizes beside a calm dog wearing the smaller fit. Show the straps, buckles and dog clearly in a bright living room. Freeze the fit comparison. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Mix Compare: two supplement flavors
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square beverage comparison ad still: two hands hold vanilla and cocoa protein drinks in plain shaker cups side by side, with the color difference clear. Bright gym lounge daylight, close counter-height framing. No text, logos, or watermark.

cards.label: Package Compare: skincare refresh
cards.prompt: Photorealistic square skincare comparison ad still: hands hold an earlier and refreshed skincare bottle design side by side, both front labels blank and fully visible. Bright vanity light, clean close composition. Freeze the packaging comparison. No text, logos, or watermark.
